transcript.text: I have a compliance finding that's critical to the disposition decision. My review found that revision-C blanks require one serialized two-dimensional code per piece and a documented scan verification before release. This requirement is in a newly issued customer addendum that has not yet been added to our local release checklist. This means any disposition plan for the revision-C blanks needs to account for this serialization and scan verification requirement before those parts can be released.
